ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, the angle between the two legs $OA$ and $OB$ of the compass is $ \angle AOB = \alpha$, with $OA = OB = 10$. What is the distance $AB$ between the two legs?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $OC \perp AB$ with the foot of the perpendicular at C, \\
$\because OA=OB=10$, $OC \perp AB$, \\
$\therefore \angle AOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOB=\frac{\alpha}{2}$, $AC=\frac{1}{2}AB$, \\
In $\triangle AOC$, $AC=AO\cdot \sin\frac{\alpha}{2}=10\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}$, \\
$\therefore AB=2AC=20\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}$, \\
Thus, $AB=\boxed{20\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}}$
